Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Portland Maine hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 17 Portland Maine hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Traveluro at 2, Vio.com at 2, Booking.com at 1, Hotel Booking Zone at 1, HotelTonight.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, Pilot at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them. These are the Portland Maine rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Portland Maine hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 11% ($16 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 9% at DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Portland, ME to 11% at Residence Inn by Marriott Portland Downtown/Waterfront. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
